pkgmetadata.longdescription: Unsloth Desktop is a Tauri application for running and training LLMs, diffusion, and audio models on local hardware. This package installs the upstream prebuilt amd64 binary from the GitHub release; it does not build the app from source. Only the desktop shell is packaged: on first launch the app bootstraps its own Python environment, including PyTorch and the unsloth wheels, into ~/.unsloth/studio, which portage neither installs nor removes.
